hero.title: Your AI Workspace, Unified.
hero.subtitle: OrangeBench brings agents, tasks, and teams into one seamless workflow.

heroModern.title: Built for teams that ship fast
heroModern.subtitle: Replace 5 tools with one AI-native workspace. OrangeBench handles research, planning, and execution in a single timeline.
heroModern.agentsDesc: Deploy specialised AI agents that handle research, writing, and analysis. Each agent works autonomously while keeping your team in the loop.
heroModern.workflowsDesc: Chain agents, approvals, and handoffs into repeatable pipelines. One workspace for ideation through delivery.
heroModern.capDesc: One workspace where agents, humans, and data converge. No tab-switching, no copy-pasting between tools.
heroModern.step1Desc: Describe what you need in plain language. OrangeBench parses intent, selects the right agent, and kicks off execution.
heroModern.step2Desc: Agents collaborate in a shared timeline. Review intermediate outputs, redirect focus, or approve results inline.
heroModern.step3Desc: Export deliverables, trigger downstream actions, and feed learnings back into the system for next time.

pricing.title: Simple pricing that scales with you
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need to. No hidden fees.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For professionals who need more power.

team.name: Team
team.description: For teams that need full control.

general.a: OrangeBench is an AI-native workspace that combines agents, task management, and team collaboration.
Small teams and indie builders who want to replace multiple tools with one unified workflow.

general.q: How is it different from Notion or Monday?
general.a: OrangeBench is built agent-first. AI executes tasks, not just stores them.

pricing_tab.a: Yes, Free tier includes 100 agent tasks per month.
Yes, monthly plans cancel anytime with no fees.

agents_tab.a: Research, summarize, execute multi-step tasks, browse the web, and more.
One task equals one agent execution from start to finish.

agents_tab.q: Can I bring my own API keys?
agents_tab.a: Yes, Pro and Team plans support BYOK.

security_tab.a: Encrypted at rest in AWS, SOC 2 compliant infrastructure.

security_tab.q: Do you train on my data?
security_tab.a: No, your data is never used for model training.
Team plan includes SSO via Google, Microsoft, and Okta.
